preconditions.description: The number of towns n must be between 1 and 100,000.
The number of roads m must be between 0 and 100,000.
The number of different types of goods k and the number of different types of goods necessary s must satisfy 1 <= s <= k <= min(n, 100).

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= k for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each town must produce a type of goods between 1 and k.
The length of the list of goods produced in each town must equal the number of towns n.
The number of roads described must equal m.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in roads)
preconditions.description: Each road must connect two distinct towns between 1 and n.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly n numbers representing the minimum expenses for each town.
Each output number must be a non-negative integer representing the minimum travel expenses.

postconditions.expression: any(int(expense) == min_expenses[i] for i, expense in enumerate(stdout.split()))
postconditions.description: Each output number must correspond to the minimum expenses calculated for holding a fair in each town.
